title: Costroid result object, version 0.13
description: What one Costroid report says about one run: figures per currency and basis, token counts by class, grades, the cap the run was given, the pull request's total, the agent's own figure in its own unit, the recorded run a report shows in place of the pull request's own, the infrastructure estimates a workflow added beside the agent's rows, apart from the figures, the P95 limit, the repository's own policy pack and its results, the receipt of developer-machine sessions the pull request's author posted, apart from the figures, and a reason when there are no figures. costroid run --json and costroid report --json print it, and the check run's machine block carries it. An object that holds no receipt is written as version 0.12 when it holds a pack, as version 0.11 when it holds a run_p95 result, and otherwise as version 0.10, or as version 0.9 when it states no estimate.

check_run_id.description: The check run that carries this object. The report creates the check run, then writes this id into the check run's object. Absent when no check run was created or that second write failed, and in what costroid run prints.

conclusion.description: The check's conclusion. Null in what costroid run prints, because no check has concluded.

state.description: What the rows file gave the report.

reason_line.description: The line of the rows file that is not a valid row. Only with the reason invalid_row.

reader_error.description: The reader's first error line, beside the run reason reader_refused. Every character outside the allowlist is replaced by ?, and the line is cut at 160 bytes.

agent_error.description: The class of error the agent ended with, read from its own result fields and never from its text. Null when the agent ended without one, or the run stated none. It can sit beside figures, because an agent can fail after some requests.

agent_skipped.description: Whether the CI system said the agent's job was skipped. Null when the report was not told the job's result.

ci_run.description: The CI run that wrote the object, as the environment states it. A claim, never verified. Null when the environment names no run.

rows_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the rows the report read, an estimate's rows included: each row's x_CostroidRowId, sorted, each followed by a line feed. Lower-case hex. Null when the rows file holds no rows, or a row names no x_CostroidRowId of 64 lower-case hex digits. Two objects with the same digest report the same rows.

rows_file_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the rows file, byte for byte, as the report read it. Lower-case hex. Null when the report could not read the file to its end.

head_sha.description: The head commit, lower case. Empty when the environment named none.

amounts.description: Whether this copy carries amounts and token counts. The check run's block and what both commands print always do. A comment's copy withholds them under comment.show_cost false on a public repository.

figures.description: One figure per currency, basis and pair of grades, the weakest enforcement grade first. No figure spans two currencies or two bases, and nothing sums across them.

cap.description: The cap the run was given, as the report was told it. Null when the report was not told it, or when amounts are withheld. It is not the policy's budget: policy.results names that limit as limit_usd.

estimates.description: The figures of the estimate rows: rows that state a cost source, name no agent and state the basis estimate, as costroid ingest-run --from focus writes them from a workflow's own FOCUS cost file. One entry per currency, source and charge period, then the estimate a workflow named that was not available. They stand apart from figures, cap, lifetime and policy, and nothing adds them to any of those, or one currency to another. Absent, with estimates_omitted, when the report states no estimate.

estimates_omitted.description: The estimate figures past the first 20, left out.

lifetime.description: The pull request's total at list, this run included, as the comment states it: one figure per currency and basis. Null off a pull request, when the earlier reports could not be read, and when amounts are withheld.

agent_stated.description: The agent's own figure for the run, in the agent's own unit, as the agent stated it. Costroid never converts it and never adds it to an amount. Null when the agent stated none, and in a copy that withholds amounts.

recorded.description: The recorded run whose rows the figures are, in place of the pull request's own: the CI run that wrote them and the day it was recorded. Null on a report on the pull request's own rows. A copy that withholds amounts states it too.

receipts.description: The receipt of developer-machine sessions that the pull request's author posted as a comment, under receipt/v0.1: its sessions priced at the report's own catalog, or why it was refused. At most one in this version. It stands apart from figures, cap, lifetime, estimates and policy, and nothing adds it to any of those, or one currency to another. Absent when the report read no receipt.

allOf.description: A version 0.13 object holds something version 0.12 cannot: a receipt.

decimal.description: A non-negative decimal string. Never a JSON number and never scientific notation.

costBasis.description: What the figure is. One value for each accuracy label.

enforcementGrade.description: What held the run to its cap.

runIdentity.description: Whether the run identity was verified from the CI system's token. A rows file the agent's own job wrote is unverified.

reason.description: Why the report shows no figures. The list is closed.

runReason.description: Why the run wrote no rows, as costroid run or costroid ingest-run stated it, or artifact_refused, which the report states when it refuses the artifact that carried the rows. Present only when one was stated. The list is closed.

class.description: The list is closed. unknown is an error the agent stated in no class this list names.

ciRun.description: GitHub Actions' GITHUB_RUN_ID and GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT. Other CI systems state none in this version.

recorded.description: A run recorded earlier. run_id is the CI run that wrote the rows, GITHUB_RUN_ID on GitHub Actions, and date the day it was recorded.

tokens.description: Token counts by class, every class the figure's rows name. reasoning_output and cached_input_reported repeat tokens that output and cache_read count.

cap.description: The cap beside the one figure it holds: the figures in its currency, when they share one basis. cost and the fields after it are null when no such figure exists.

enforcement_grade.description: The weakest enforcement grade of the figures. Null with no figures.

remainder.description: amount minus cost, 0 when cost is above amount.

overshoot.description: cost minus amount, 0 when cost is within amount.

overshoot_tokens.description: The billed tokens of the request that took cost past amount and of every request that ended after it, in the order the requests ended. Null when the rows hold too many requests to keep.

data.description: Strings that originated in the pull request. Each passed an allowlist, and one that failed it reads not-shown.

policy.description: The policy's verdict, present when a policy ran. docs/policy.md states each field. The comment's copy drops limit_usd, cost_usd, baseline_usd and p95_usd when it withholds amounts.

limit_percent.description: The increase over the baseline a run may reach, in percent. Only under run_increase_percent.

cost_usd.description: The run's cost in USD, and under pr_budget the pull request's total, this run included.

baseline_usd.description: The median of the agent's earlier runs, in USD, that the increase rules compare the run with.

models.description: The models outside policy.models, sorted, at most 10. Only under model_allowlist.

p95_usd.description: The nearest-rank P95 of the agent's latest 20 runs on pull requests merged into the base branch, in USD. Only under run_p95, beside a baseline of 20 runs.

limit_factor.description: policy.max_p95_factor in its shortest form, at least 1 and below 10,000. A run that costs more than p95_usd times this factor is over its limit. Only under run_p95, where it is required.

baseline_runs.description: The earlier runs the baseline holds, at most 20. Only under run_p95: 20 when the rule ran, and fewer with the reason no_baseline, when it did not.

line.description: The line of the policy pack the compiler named. Only with the reason pack_invalid, and absent when the compiler named no line.

lifetime.description: The lines the comment states under the figures. Figures with the same currency and basis are added up over the reports on every commit of the pull request; nothing is added across a currency or a basis.

figures.description: At most 10, sorted by currency, then by basis.

figures_omitted.description: The totals past the first 10, left out.

capped.description: True when the host listed as many commits of the pull request as it lists, 250 on GitHub, so a later commit can be missing from the figures.

unread.description: The check runs left out because their result object could not be read or added up.

reports.description: The reports in the sum. Reports with the same rows_sha256 count once.

may_repeat.description: True when the sum holds two or more reports and one of them states no rows_sha256, so a report over the same rows can be counted twice.

agentStated.description: A figure the agent stated about its own run, in the one unit that agent states it in. gh-aw states its AI credits: the last ai_credits_total of the agent job's records and of the threat detection job's, added up in gh-aw's own unit. OpenCode states its own price for each step, part.cost, from its own price list, added up in USD. Copilot CLI states totalNanoAiu, in nano-AI units, as it wrote it, 0 included.

unit.description: The agent's own unit. AIC is gh-aw's AI credits, USD is OpenCode's own price, and nano-AIU is Copilot CLI's nano-AI units.

source.description: The agent that stated the figure. Each agent states it in one unit.

statedQuantity.description: A non-negative decimal string, every digit the agent wrote kept. Never a JSON number and never scientific notation.

instant.description: A UTC instant to the second, as FOCUS writes a charge period's bounds.

estimate.description: A figure, or an estimate that was not available. An entry with a reason is the second.

estimateFigure.description: The exact sum of ListCost over the estimate rows that share a currency, a source and a charge period: rows that state a cost source, name no agent and state the basis estimate, as ingest-run --from focus writes them.

source.description: The rows' costroid/cost_source, as the comment names it. not-shown when it fails the allowlist.

cost_basis.description: Always estimate. A figure of another basis is no estimate, and this array never holds one.

estimateNotAvailable.description: An estimate the workflow named, with ingest-run --optional, that was not there.

source.description: The source the estimate would have come from.

reason.description: Why it was not available. The list is closed. no_file: the file was not there, because the step that writes it did not run or wrote nothing, as on a fork's pull request that gets no secret.

pack.description: The repository's own policy pack, as costroid.yml names it with policy_pack, read at config_ref, and its results. pack_sha256 still names Costroid's own rules.

path.description: The pack's path in the repository, relative to its root: no . or .. segment, ending .rego.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the bytes read, lower-case hex, and of zero bytes when none were read.

results.description: The pack's own results, at most 32, apart from policy.results. Empty when the pack returned none, and when a customer_pack result states why the pack did not run to its end.

rule.description: The pack's own rule id. It names the pack's rule even where it repeats one of Costroid's.

outcome.description: A pack has no word for pass. A result that states anything else faults the pack.

message.description: The pack's own text. Every character outside the allowlist is replaced by ?, and the text is cut at 160 bytes.

held_by_warn_only.description: The pack's fail, held to warn by the warn-only period.

receipt.description: A receipt the report read, or one it refused. An entry with a reason is the second.

receiptComment.description: The comment the receipt came from, as the host states it: its id, when it was created, and the SHA-256 of its body, byte for byte, as the host returned it. It names no login.

receiptRead.description: The sessions of a receipt the report read, priced at the catalog the report's binary loads. The receipt states counts and no price.

first_day.description: The first UTC day of the receipt's entries.

last_day.description: The last UTC day of the receipt's entries.

figures.description: One figure per currency. No figure spans two currencies, and nothing sums across them.

receiptFigure.description: The exact sum of ListCost over the rows the report built from the receipt in one currency. The rows carry costroid/origin developer_machine and are written to no file.

cost_basis.description: Always list_equivalent: the session file does not state how a session was billed.

receiptRefused.description: A receipt the report refused, and read none of. It carries no amount and no sessions.

reason.description: Why the receipt was refused. The list is closed. receipt_edited: the comment was edited after it was posted. receipt_other_branch: the receipt names another branch than the pull request's. receipt_invalid: the comment is not a valid receipt. receipts_off: costroid.yml on the base branch turns receipts off.
